Name: Stardew Local API (Developer tools includes event builder) - No Longer Maintained
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.


[b]What does this mod do?[/b]
Stardew Local API is a mod used for creating and testing mods. This mod is still in Alpha so there may be bugs, but I've tested as much as I can with the various commands. The mod's intent is to assist in building content patch type mods. The mod currently can build events, run them, and creates the content patcher mod for it with i18n.

[b]Features include:[/b]
[list]
[*]Build events (UI + run events + run events as a content patcher mod)[/*]
[*]Plays events, dialogue, sounds, and music.[/*]
[/list]
[b]How it works?[/b]
1. Once a save game is loaded you can press F11 to open your workspace.
2. The game will run in the background, and the workspace is where you will build your mod. 
3. CP folder is included so when you test CP it writes your event into that CP folder that this mod comes with so you can reload and retest instead of having to restart the game.

[b]What still needs work? [/b]
Not all commands for Preconditions and Step Commands have been implemented and so the Raw command is provided for both to allow you to enter normal commands. Not all listing may be complete.


[b]Demo[/b]
[youtube]vDxYa3erTUY[/youtube]

[b]Important[/b]
Save often. Don't close game while workspace is up or you won't be able to save progress.
